title: Use of Continuous Glucose Monitors in Children and Adolescents With Obesity
official: Use of Continuous Glucose Monitors in Children and Adolescents With Obesity
summary: To study if continuous glucose monitors are feasible for use in children and adolescents with obesity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 10-21 years BMI \>95th percentile

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous diagnosis of Prader Willi Syndrome or hypothalamic obesity
* Intellectual disability
* Previous or planned bariatric surgery
* Hemoglobin A1c \>6.5 %
* Current use of medication that impacts weight

sites.f: Pediatric Endocrinology Division, University of California
